title: Lost Vape E Plus Replacement Pods 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The Lost Vape E Plus Replacement Pod Cartridges are designed to enhance your vaping with precise performance and a versatile design. Each pod offers a 2ml capacity and is available in Three resistance options: 0.3Ohm for RDL vaping up to 40W, 0.45ohm for DTL and 0.6Ohm for MTL vaping up to 22W. Compatible with the Lost Vape Thelema Elite Art 40 , Thelema Elite S, Centaurus E40 Max these pods ensure seamless performance and integration. The side-filling system makes refilling effortless, providing a hassle-free and customizable vaping experience. Whether you prefer a direct lung hit or a tighter mouth-to-lung draw, these pods cater to every vaper's needs. Pod Details: 0.3ohm DTL - Use High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-Liquids 0.45ohm Dual Mesh DTL - Use High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-Liquids 0.6ohm RDL/MTL - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 (freebase) E-Liquids 0.6ohm Dual Mesh RDL/MTL - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 (freebase) E-Liquids Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
